# Local Community Health

> > Local Community Health showcases healthcare providers at Finger Lakes Community Health centers across New York's Finger Lakes region, including Penn Yan, Bath, Geneva, and Sodus locations.

This website features provider profiles highlighting the dedicated family nurse practitioners, physicians, physician assistants, and dentists serving rural communities through patient-centered primary care, chronic disease management, addiction medicine, and dental services.

## Key Topics

- Finger Lakes Community Health (FLCH)
- Penn Yan Community Health
- Sodus Community Health
- Bath Community Health
- Geneva Community Health
- Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP)
- Primary Care
- Community Health Centers
- Patient-Centered Care
- Chronic Disease Management
- Family Medicine
- Addiction Medicine
- Dental Services
- Provider Profiles
- Rural Healthcare

## Primary Care Providers

- [Meet Lauren White, FNP, Penn Yan and Bath Community Health](https://www.localcommunityhealth.com/meet-lauren-white-fnp-penn-yan-community-health): Profile of FNP Lauren White at Penn Yan and Bath Community Health
- [Meet Mackenzie (Mack) Stanley, FNP, Geneva Community Health](https://www.localcommunityhealth.com/meet-mackenzie-mack-stanley-fnp-geneva-community-health): Profile of FNP Mackenzie Stanley at Geneva Community Health
- [Meet Dr. Azfar Ahmed, Penn Yan Community Health](https://www.localcommunityhealth.com/meet-dr-azfar-ahmed-penn-yan-community-health): Profile of Dr. Azfar Ahmed, family medicine physician at Penn Yan
- [Meet Amy Melendez, PA, Sodus Community Health](https://www.localcommunityhealth.com/meet-amy-melendez-pa-sodus-community-health): Profile of PA Amy Melendez, bilingual provider at Sodus Community Health
